data.name: ConnectKeyDetail
data.value: Plug the key into the phone's USB port, or hold it flat against the back of the phone.

data.name: ConnectKeyDetailUsb
data.value: Plug the key into the phone's USB port (USB-C, or with an OTG adapter).

data.name: KeepHolding
data.value: Keep holding the key against the phone...

data.name: UnlockHintMobile
data.value: Tap Unlock and type your key's PIN. Then plug in the key or hold it to the phone, and touch it if it blinks.

data.name: OtpNotSupported
data.value: This vault opens with a YubiKey OTP slot, which the phone cannot use. Use the recovery code, or register a FIDO2 security key in this vault on a computer.

data.name: EmptyFolder
data.value: This folder is empty. Tap Add files to encrypt files into it.

data.name: CreateIntroMobile
data.value: A vault is a single .yvault file. Next you choose where to save it: on the phone, on a memory card or in a cloud folder. From the outside nobody sees names, sizes or contents.

data.name: CouldNotSave
data.value: Could not save the vault. Your changes are kept on this phone; lock the vault to try again.

data.name: PinLength
data.value: A security key PIN has 4 to 63 characters.
